sn45.42-47:1.3: For the series listing the fetters, underlying tendencies, course of time, and end of defilements, see [sn48.64]() and notes.
sn45.42-47:1.5: _Addhāna_ (“course of time”) is a word for “transmigration” (_saṁsāra_), usually expressed as the “past (course)” and “future (course)” ([sn12.20:5.2]()). It is rooted in the metaphor of a journey, especially the long, dark road of the stars, sun and moon in the sky (eg. Rig Veda 1.113.3, 6.12.3, 6.29.2). Contrast the “first beginning” and “final end” ([mn79:7.5]()).
